title: Bala de Canon Cantaloupe Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw: Shake ingredients with ice and strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice. Garnish.

Cantaloupe PuréeSkin a ripe cantaloupe and cut the fruit into chunks, reserving the seeds and pulp. Purée in a blender (with the seeds, which add flavorful complexity) until smooth; press through a fine strainer to remove solids. Refrigerate and use within 2 days.
